kit-media.error.CHAT_KEY_REFUSED: That looks like a key or an id number. Chausar never keeps those here, so nothing was saved.
kit-media.error.APP_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Do this in the Chausar app, where you approve changes.
kit-media.error.ASSET_LICENCE_UNKNOWN: No known licence. Record where it came from, or take it out.
kit-media.error.ASSET_NOT_MADE: Asked for again and not made yet. Run the order again, or use the old file.
kit-media.error.ASSET_REFUSED: This file cannot be used that way.
kit-media.error.MEDIA_NOT_CLEAN: This clip still has its location data, so it cannot go out. Add ffmpeg to this computer, then run the order again to clean it.
kit-media.error.CONSENT_WITHDRAWN: Made with a voice whose consent was withdrawn. Take it out.
kit-media.error.DERIVED_STALE: The file it was made from changed after it was made. Make it again.
kit-media.error.CONSENT_REQUIRED: This voice has no current consent. Record the speaker's consent first.
